bullet_facts.fact: Nellie and Dwight have a personal history, including a past romantic relationship and a breakup, with Nellie describing how he ran off with a waitress and sold their flat (S08E20:chunk:000012).
Dwight and Nellie share moments of flirtation, such as Nellie asking Dwight to meet her in seven minutes for some one-on-one time (S08E16:chunk:000021).
Nellie owned a flat with someone who left her, and she describes it as a painful memory (S08E20:chunk:000012).
Dwight and Nellie have engaged in humorous and tense interactions, including Dwight threatening to cut off Nellie's hand with a cleaver (S09E02:chunk:000016).

supporting_quotes.quote: Nellie: God. We owned this flat together. Then one morning, just like that, he was gone. He ran off with the waitress at our favorite restaurant.
